'''Toborro's Glittering Fury''' was a golden [[isotope-5 droid]] built for the personal use of [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Toborro]]. It was ultimately destroyed in [[Toborro's Palace]] shortly before [[Toborro]]'s own [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TOR" />
